description: `fathom export --json`: the report of one artefact write. The artefact itself is the file on disk (markdown, HTML or the JSON record); this payload is the machine line about the run — what was exported, where it went, what the artefact concluded, and what it refused. Byte-stability lives in the artefact, not here: this payload carries the destination, so it is a record of a run.

artifact.description: The file name written, stem plus the format's extension.

checklist_open.description: The open half of the operator-action checklist, each with the owner of the rest and what to type.

out.description: The stem the operator asked for, echoed.

record.description: The artefact's own contract: `fathom-review-record/1`, who wrote it, the seven sections' states straight out of the delta model, and the self-check's verdict.

scope.description: The resolved range: what was asked, the endpoints as short oids, whether they resolved, how many commits and episodes, their ids, and the order the artefact prints them in.

sha256.description: sha256 of the artefact's bytes, so a reader can pin the file they were sent.

signoffs.description: Every ledger entry in scope, with reviewer, kind, instant, decision, dismissal reason and note.

status.description: `written` — an export that writes nothing is a refusal and carries an exit code, not a payload.

summary.description: The summary card's numbers: scale, decisions taken and outstanding, findings, open actions, and the verdict sentence.

title: fathom export --json

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: OK
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: the artefact was written and its self-check found nothing

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: ERROR
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: a rev that names nothing, an unresolvable range, an unwritable destination, or an artefact whose self-check failed

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: USAGE
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: clap rejected the command line, or `--format` named a format that is not markdown, html or json

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: NOT_A_REPOSITORY
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: --root is not a git repository, or `.git` is unreadable

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: CHECK_VIOLATIONS
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: --strict was given and the artefact's checklist still has an open item (CI reads this)

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: INDEX_DEGRADED
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: there is no index to build the artefact from, or a commit in the range has no episode row; the remedy is printed

x-fathom-note: The skeleton that shipped before e5.7 answered with status `not_implemented`, `writes_file: false` and exit 1 on every call, so no consumer could treat it as a data source; the finished verb is the first version of this contract, not a change to one.
